title: Who can see what?
subtitle: Pick the module you are writing code in, then the item you want to use

rule.priv: private: visible only inside {scope} and its descendants
rule.super: pub(super): visible inside the parent module {scope} and its descendants
rule.crate: pub(crate): visible anywhere in this crate, never in other crates
rule.pub: pub: visible anywhere its parent path is visible, other crates included

ok: Accessible. Every segment of the path is visible from {from}.
blocked: Error E0603 / E0451: {item} is private from here. The compiler stops at the first segment you cannot see.
